sentences.en: I get a lot of satisfaction out of my work.
sentences.zh: 我在工作中得到了很多满足感。

sentences.en: General prosperity and satisfaction are the best deterrents to revolution.
sentences.zh: 普遍的繁荣和满足感能够最好地防止革命。

sentences.en: It doesn't give me any satisfaction to prove you wrong.
sentences.zh: 证明你是错的，并不能给我带来任何满足感。

senses.zh: 满足，满意，舒服,妥善处理,（债务的）清偿,（伤害的）赔偿
